text: Completed in 0421640. ravel-packed now reuses core Shape, Slice, Layout, NarrowPlan, and PermutationPlan; supports rank-zero and zero extents; separates axis-preserving slice from axis-dropping select; normalizes negative axes and indices; exposes checked and throwing narrow/permutation forms; and has fixed-rank compile-time access plus Vector-model coverage. Evidence: packedJVM/test 21/21, packedJS/test 19/19, fmtCheck, docsCheck, and diff checks passed.
